newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise at mid-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon forex reserves rise at mid-Feb.

text.p: The bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose by $30.55 million in the first half of February to $6,171.1 million, according to the the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet published on Tuesday.
Gross reserves gained $104.62 million in the second half of January to $6,140.55 million.
Gross reserves include commercial bank's foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves, but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $4,200 million in mid February.
Net reserves were $4,100 million at the end of January. They stood at $4,015 million at the end of 1996 compared with $2,858 million a year earlier. They were $2,732 million at the end of 1994.
